name: Aid-Climbing Top-Step Balance Iso
description: High-foot single-leg balance hold with one hand grip — direct aid-climbing top-step transfer.
instructions_excerpt: Place one foot on a knee-height box. Rise fully, gripping a light overhead handle with one hand. Hold stacked tall for 15-30s per side.

name: Alpine Start Warm-Up Flow
description: Full-body dynamic warm-up designed for cold-morning mountaineering starts.
instructions_excerpt: Cycle: 20 arm circles forward/back, 10 leg swings per side, 10 bodyweight squats, 10 walking lunges per side, 10 mountain climbers, 10 inchworms. Repeat 2 rounds. 5-8 minutes.

name: Arm Swings (Warm-up)
description: Dynamic shoulder warm-up — ranges the shoulder in every plane.
instructions_excerpt: Stand tall. Swing both arms forward in large circles for 10-15 reps. Reverse for 10-15 reps. Then swing across the body (hug yourself). Then up-and-down.

name: Balance-Board Swivel Squat
description: Squat on balance board — vestibular and ankle training for land-sailing, sailing, gliding.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a balance board. Squat to a shallow depth while stabilizing. 6-8 reps. Work up to deeper squats.

name: Banded Shoulder Dislocation (Warmup)
description: Dynamic shoulder mobility drill — critical for swim stroke entry position.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a band (or PVC) wide overhead. Slowly rotate the band from in front of the body, overhead, and behind (keeping arms straight), then reverse. Move through the full shoulder ROM.

name: Bike Handling Slalom Drill
description: Tight slalom through cones — handling skill and core for MTB, cyclocross, BMX.
instructions_excerpt: Set cones 3-5 m apart. Slalom through them at moderate pace, then return faster. 4-6 sets. Work on looking ahead, not down.

name: BOSU Single-Leg Balance
description: Balance on a BOSU (dome up) one-legged — builds the proprioceptive base for surfing, SUP, wakeboarding.
instructions_excerpt: Step on the BOSU with one foot, soft bend in the knee. Hold balance 20-40 seconds. Progress to eyes closed or ball toss with a partner.

name: Bosu Squat to Rotation
description: Squat-and-twist on an unstable platform — trains the rotational carve of surf and snowboard.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on the flat side of a Bosu or soft side. Squat to parallel, then rotate the torso to face one side and return. Alternate. 8 per side.

name: Calisthenics Skill Scale-Pose
description: Side-scale balance pose — calisthenics/movement-culture skill.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg. Raise the other leg out to the side to 90 degrees, arms balanced. Hold 10-20s per side.

name: Capoeira Ginga Flow
description: Rhythmic ginga step — foundational capoeira rhythm-and-movement pattern.
instructions_excerpt: Alternate back-step and side-step with arms rising in counter-rhythm. 2-3 min continuous at musical tempo.

name: Cat-Cow + Thread-the-Needle Combo (Warm-up)
description: Combined spinal mobility warm-up — pairs flexion-extension with rotation.
instructions_excerpt: Perform 5 slow cat-cows. On the last cow position, thread one arm under the other and hold 2 seconds; return to neutral. Do 5 thread-the-needle on each side. Repeat the cycle once.

name: Chaînés Turn Prep (Spot Turns)
description: Linked turning prep with spotting — primary turn drill for multiple dance forms.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with feet together. Step and turn 180° in one direction, snapping the head quickly to maintain a focal spot. Step and turn another 180°. Continue in a line.

name: Contemporary Dance Floor Roll
description: Controlled roll from standing to floor and back — contemporary dance floor-work essential.
instructions_excerpt: From standing, melt down through the spine to the floor one segment at a time, roll across the back, and rise smoothly back to standing using the opposite side.

name: Dance Hip Isolation Drill
description: Isolated hip circles — fundamental salsa/bachata/hip-hop core-rotation drill.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with a wide stance, knees slightly bent, upper body still. Circle the hips in one direction for 8 reps. Reverse for 8. Progress to figure-8s.

name: Dodgeball Catch-and-Throw Reaction
description: Reactive catch-and-throw drill with a med-ball — dodgeball/kickball transition.
instructions_excerpt: Partner tosses a 4-6 lb med-ball at unpredictable heights. Catch and return with rotational throw. 30-45s rounds.

name: Dressage Seated Balance Iso
description: Seated balance-ball hold in dressage posture — rider seat stability.
instructions_excerpt: Sit on a stability ball in dressage posture (shoulders-hip-heel aligned, tall spine). Hold 60-120s without feet touching.

name: Foam-Pad Single-Leg Balance
description: Single-leg stand on a foam pad or Bosu — the baseline progression for slackline prep and ankle-sprain rehab.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one foot on a foam pad, balance board, or Bosu. Hold for 30-45 seconds. Progress by closing the eyes, adding head turns, or performing reaching motions with the free leg.

name: Hip Airplane
description: Standing single-leg rotational balance — bulletproofs hip stability for pitchers, cutters, and runners.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg, hinge forward at the hip until torso is parallel to the floor, free leg extended behind. Rotate the lifted hip open (external rotation), then closed (internal rotation). Continuous flow.

name: Hip Airplane (Ski Carving)
description: Single-leg hip disassociation drill — trains the rotational ankle-hip chain needed for ski and skate carving.
instructions_excerpt: Balance on one leg with a slight knee bend. Hinge forward at the hip, back leg extending behind. Rotate the pelvis open and closed around the standing hip without losing alignment. 6-8 reps per side.

name: Hollow-to-Arch Rock
description: Transition between hollow and arch — gymnastics warm-up staple.
instructions_excerpt: Start in hollow body. Roll to prone and into arch body position. Roll back to hollow. Maintain tension throughout each position.

name: Hydrofoil Pump Balance-Board Drill
description: Balance-board pump drill — hydrofoiling-specific bob/pump motion.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a balance board. Rhythmic hip pump loading front-back with small knee bend. 30-60s sets.

name: Hydrofoil Pump-Balance Drill
description: Balance + micro-squat drill simulating hydrofoil pumping cadence.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a balance board. Small continuous knee-bend pumps (5-10 deg) without losing balance. 30-60 sec.

name: Indo Board Balance Drill
description: Indo board rocking balance — surf/SUP-specific dynamic balance training.
instructions_excerpt: Place feet shoulder-width on an indo board. Rock side-to-side or hold steady for 30-90 seconds. Progress to squats or catching a ball on the board.

name: Indo Board Balance Hold
description: Balance board hold — foundation for surf, wake, kite, wing, hydrofoil stance.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on an indo board or balance board with feet shoulder-width. Find balance. Hold 30-60 sec. Progress to light squat and small rotations.

name: Jumping Jacks (Warm-up)
description: General cardiovascular warm-up — 2 minutes raises body temperature.
instructions_excerpt: Standard jumping jacks: jump with feet wide while arms raise overhead; return. 2 minutes continuous.

name: Kung-Fu Crane Balance
description: One-leg crane stance hold — foundational kung-fu balance pose.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg, opposite knee lifted, opposite arm raised in crane beak. Hold 20-45s per side.

name: Leg Swings (Warm-up)
description: Dynamic hip and leg warm-up — multi-planar range-of-motion flow.
instructions_excerpt: Stand next to a wall for balance. Swing one leg forward and back 10-15 times. Then swing side-to-side across the body. Switch legs.

name: Long-Toss Warm-Up Progression
description: Throwing-distance progression drill — the arm-care staple used by baseball and softball players to prep the shoulder for competition.
instructions_excerpt: Start with easy 15-ft tosses (20 throws), progress to 45 ft (15 throws), 60 ft (10 throws), 90+ ft (5-8 throws). Focus on crow-hop mechanics and clean arm action. Scale distances to available space.

name: Mountain-Board Carve Shift Drill
description: Lateral weight-shift carving drill on a balance board — mountain-boarding/downhill specific.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a balance board, riding stance. Shift weight heel-to-toe in a smooth carve rhythm for 30-45s.

name: Reaction Ball Catch
description: Drop and catch a reaction ball — pure hand-eye reactive training for racquet ball tracking.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in an athletic stance holding a reaction ball at shoulder height. Drop it, let it bounce once, and catch it with one hand. Alternate hands. 20-30 catches per side.

name: Reaction Ball Drop and Catch
description: Proprioception drill with a reaction ball — builds the first-step quickness and hand reactivity for all team sports.
instructions_excerpt: Hold reaction ball at shoulder height. Drop it, let it bounce once, catch it on the unpredictable rebound. 30-60 sec continuous work per set.

name: Salsa Cross-Step Drill
description: Cross-body rhythmic step with hip action — the foundational Latin footwork drill.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in a comfortable stance. Step forward with one foot across the body on count 1, replace on 2, step back on 3. Reverse sides on 5-7. Emphasize hip motion on each step.

name: Senior-Friendly Golf Mobility Warmup
description: Short mobility warm-up for 55+ golfers — hip, thoracic, shoulder prep with no load.
instructions_excerpt: Cycle: 5 hip circles per side, 5 arm circles forward / back, 5 torso rotations, 5 bodyweight squats. 2 rounds.

name: Shotgun Mount Stability Drill
description: Single-leg shoulder-mount drill — trains the stability required to mount and swing a shotgun consistently in trap/skeet/sporting clays.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg. With a PVC pipe or unloaded shotgun, practice mounting to the shoulder/cheek weld 8-10 times. Then "swing" through a target arc 5 times. Switch legs.

name: Single-Leg Balance (Eyes Closed)
description: Proprioceptive single-leg stand with eyes closed — foundation for every board sport.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg, soft knee. Close eyes. Maintain balance for 20-45 sec. Switch sides.

name: Single-Leg Balance with Reach
description: Neuromuscular control — ankle stability and hip control.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg, slight knee bend. Reach forward, then across, then back with the other leg while maintaining balance. 3 reaches per direction; switch sides.

name: Single-Leg Slackline Stance Progression
description: Stance-to-single-leg balance progression on a slackline — the core skill for slacklining and highlining.
instructions_excerpt: On a rigged slackline (low tension, short span), mount with one foot centered. Find balance; try raising the other foot briefly, then lower. Progress to full single-leg stance and walking.

name: Slack-Line Walk Across
description: Full walk across a slackline — slacklining skill progression.
instructions_excerpt: On a short low slackline, walk from one anchor to the other. Start with a spotter. 3-5 full crossings.

name: Slackline Dynamic Turn Drill
description: Turnaround walking on a slackline — builds dynamic balance beyond static holds.
instructions_excerpt: Walk 2-3 steps on a low slackline, pause, rotate 180 deg, walk back. 4-6 turnarounds.

name: Slackline Static Single-Leg
description: Single-leg balance hold on a slackline — highline/slackline balance skill.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a low slackline with one foot. Hold 15-30 sec. Use eyes on a fixed point. Switch sides.

name: Slackline Walk
description: Dynamic full-body balance on a moving line — proprioceptive dynamite for any wheeled sport.
instructions_excerpt: Anchor a slackline 12-18 inches off the ground between two trees/posts. Step on, find balance, and walk. Arms out for balance. Fall safely.

name: Sparring-Ready Rider Mobility Flow
description: Short full-body mobility flow before riding — hips, thoracic, ankle.
instructions_excerpt: Cycle: 5 hip circles per side, 5 thoracic rotations per side, 5 ankle circles per side, 5 cat-cow. 3 rounds.

name: Static Balance with Rifle/Bow Mount
description: Static single-leg balance while holding a rifle/bow mount — real-hunt prep.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg in a soft shoe. Mount a rifle or bow (or PVC). Hold 30-45s. Switch.

name: Swing-Dance Triple-Step Drill
description: Rhythmic triple-step pattern at musical tempo — swing-dance and lindy hop specific.
instructions_excerpt: Triple-step (step-step-step) right, triple-step left in swing rhythm. 2-3 min continuous with breaks.

name: Tai Chi Weight Shift
description: Slow controlled weight transfer between legs — balance and joint-health drill for older practitioners.
instructions_excerpt: Stand wide. Slowly shift 100% of weight to one leg, lifting the other heel or foot slightly. Hold 2 seconds. Shift fully to the other leg. Move with deliberate slowness.

name: Tai-Chi Single Whip Pose Flow
description: Single-whip pose transition — tai chi flowing balance and mobility.
instructions_excerpt: Step out into a wide stance with one arm extended, opposite fingertips pinched. Hold 10-20s per side. 3-4 transitions.

name: Turn-Prep Pirouette Drill
description: Pirouette passé prep — stand on single leg in relevé with the other foot at the knee.
instructions_excerpt: Start in fourth position. Brush the working leg up to passé while rising onto the supporting leg's relevé. Hold the passé-relevé shape 3-5 seconds. Switch.

name: Wrist Circles + Finger Flicks
description: Combined warm-up flow: wrist circumduction + dynamic finger-extension flicks — fast warm-up for the hand and wrist before a match.
instructions_excerpt: Hold arms in front. Make 10 slow wrist circles in each direction. Then: make a fist, flick all fingers open explosively. Repeat 15-20 times. Combine for a 2-minute warm-up.
